extracted.intended_audience: machine learning researchers, NeurIPS authors and reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: A checklist for ML paper authors and reviewers to ensure sufficient documentation for reproducibility (mathematical descriptions, data, code, experiments, and theoretical claims). Incorporated into NeurIPS submission requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: A clear description of the mathematical setting, algorithm, and/or model
rubrics_metrics.description: A clear description of the mathematical setting, algorithm, and/or model
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to all models and algorithms presented; ensure the mathematical formulation and the algorithmic steps or model architecture are described clearly enough to be understood and reproduced.

rubrics_metrics.name: A clear explanation of any assumptions
rubrics_metrics.description: A clear explanation of any assumptions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State all modeling, statistical, or experimental assumptions (e.g., independence, stationarity, data generation assumptions) that affect results or applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: An analysis of the complexity (time, space, sample size) of any algorithm
rubrics_metrics.description: An analysis of the complexity (time, space, sample size) of any algorithm
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide theoretical or empirical analysis of algorithmic cost: runtime, memory usage, and sample complexity where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: A clear statement of the claim
rubrics_metrics.description: A clear statement of the claim
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For any theoretical claim, precisely state the theorem/lemma/result being claimed, including conditions and scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: A complete proof of the claim
rubrics_metrics.description: A complete proof of the claim
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include full proofs (not sketches) for theoretical claims, or point to a publicly available appendix/technical report with the complete proof.

rubrics_metrics.name: The relevant statistics, such as number of examples
rubrics_metrics.description: The relevant statistics, such as number of examples
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For every dataset used, report statistics like dataset size, class balance, missing values, and other descriptive statistics necessary to understand the data.

rubrics_metrics.name: The details of train / validation / test splits
rubrics_metrics.description: The details of train / validation / test splits
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how data were partitioned (random/sequential/stratified), exact split sizes, and whether splits were fixed or resampled across runs.

rubrics_metrics.name: An explanation of any data that were excluded, and all pre-processing steps
rubrics_metrics.description: An explanation of any data that were excluded, and all pre-processing steps
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document exclusions (with reasons) and every preprocessing transformation (normalization, filtering, augmentation) applied to data.

rubrics_metrics.name: A link to a downloadable version of the dataset or simulation environment
rubrics_metrics.description: A link to a downloadable version of the dataset or simulation environment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide persistent download links or instructions to access datasets or environments used in experiments; if not public, explain restrictions and how to reproduce data.

rubrics_metrics.name: For new data collected, a complete description of the data collection process, such as instructions to annotators and methods for quality control
rubrics_metrics.description: For new data collected, a complete description of the data collection process, such as instructions to annotators and methods for quality control
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When publishing new datasets, include protocols, annotation guidelines, annotator selection/training, inter-annotator agreement metrics, and QC procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification of dependencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Specification of dependencies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For shared code, list software/library dependencies (including versions), system requirements, and environment setup instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training code
rubrics_metrics.description: Training code
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the code used to train models (scripts, notebooks) so others can reproduce model training procedures and hyperparameter settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation code
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation code
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide code that computes reported metrics and evaluation procedures, including post-processing and any scripts used to produce figures/tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: (Pre-)trained model(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: (Pre-)trained model(s)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Release trained model checkpoints where possible, or provide instructions to obtain them; document how models were saved and loaded.

rubrics_metrics.name: README file including table of results accompanied by precise commands to run/produce those results
rubrics_metrics.description: README file including table of results accompanied by precise commands to run/produce those results
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a top-level README describing repository structure, reproduction steps, and exact commands to reproduce reported results and tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: The range of hyperparameters considered, method to select the best hyperparameter configuration, and specification of all hyperparameters used to generate results
rubrics_metrics.description: The range of hyperparameters considered, method to select the best hyperparameter configuration, and specification of all hyperparameters used to generate results
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report search ranges, tuning procedures (e.g., grid/random/search budget, validation protocol), selection criteria, and the exact hyperparameter values used for reported runs.

rubrics_metrics.name: The exact number of training and evaluation runs
rubrics_metrics.description: The exact number of training and evaluation runs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State how many independent runs were performed (e.g., seeds), whether results are averaged, and how many evaluations per configuration were done.

rubrics_metrics.name: A clear definition of the specific measure or statistics used to report results
rubrics_metrics.description: A clear definition of the specific measure or statistics used to report results
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define metrics (including implementation details), any aggregation/statistical estimators used, and what higher-level claims those metrics support.

rubrics_metrics.name: A description of results with central tendency (e.g. mean) and variation (e.g. error bars)
rubrics_metrics.description: A description of results with central tendency (e.g. mean) and variation (e.g. error bars)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report mean/median and variability (standard deviation, confidence intervals, error bars) across runs; avoid reporting single-run results without variation.

rubrics_metrics.name: The average runtime for each result, or estimated energy cost
rubrics_metrics.description: The average runtime for each result, or estimated energy cost
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide runtime measurements (e.g., wall-clock training time) and/or energy estimates so computational cost can be compared and reproduced.

rubrics_metrics.name: A description of the computing infrastructure used
rubrics_metrics.description: A description of the computing infrastructure used
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document hardware (GPUs/TPUs/CPUs), number of devices, memory, OS, and cluster/configuration details relevant to reproducing timings and scalability.
